caseNameFull: Janice Bonner v. City of Indianapolis. Jacque Durham v. City of Indianapolis
attorneys: William C. Erbecker for appellants., Patrick J. Smith for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motions to dismiss are granted and the appeals are dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeals were taken as petitions for writs of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
